program_history: New ACGME program (new-format ACGME ID 1601700001). Status in 2026: 'Continued Accreditation without Outcomes', which follows initial accreditation. Kulwin is listed as associate PD from 2024. First PGY-1 class entered 2025-07. Not an ex-AOA program: there is no earlier St. Vincent neurosurgery residency on any host or in PubMed affiliations. The pre-2017 goodmancampbell.com rosters are Indiana University's (program 28). The program is 7 years long (PGY-6 chief, PGY-7 enfolded fellowship), so the first graduation is expected 2032.
